crownPassive.name: Hard frost
crownPassive.text: In every round that you hold the Fate token, all enemy cards have -2 Speed (never below 1).

bond.name: Eventyr kin
bond.text: +1 Guard for each other Eventyr hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Two strikes at the card, each for her Attack.

actions.name: Frozen kiss
actions.text: A Spell for 2 on any enemy card, ignoring Guard.

actions.name: Shard of the mirror
actions.text: This round, an enemy hero's attack hits one of its own adjacent cards instead. Each hero can only be targeted once a fight.
